notes: PAP reference G28/3378. Whole four-room duplex in central Chartres' Petite Venise district, on the third and top floor of a 1998 coproperty. The complete advert describes a 30 m2 living room with open kitchen, three bedrooms, dressing room, shower room, two WCs, pantry, south-west balcony and private parking; a separately rented box may be available but is not represented as part of the sale. The seller explicitly states an elevator, individual electric heating, double glazing, DPE D and GES B. The coproperty has 40 apartments and no disclosed current procedure or planned major works. The live text contains no tenant, lease, occupied-sale, delayed-vacancy or special-sale wording. PAP exposed 6 property photos and a publication date of 30 September 2026.
